owner: current ChannelRuntime (USE dispatch of a rune; rune casting, RUNE-CAST-1)
offer_gate: RUNE-CAST-1: the server does not offer this capability before rune casting ships. It extends command type 2 with the UseWithV1 position arm (field 5, a SpellTargetPositionV1 in the SPELL-D7 frame, at most 16 bytes, valid only for a rune) and with dispositions 18 TARGET_ILLEGAL and 19 PROTECTION_ZONE, and owns no command type or domain; the intent stays at most 529 bytes (RUNEUSE0-RL-04) and the result at most 4. A pacified or powerless rune refusal is REQUIREMENT_NOT_MET on the wire (§6.1). Without it selected, a rune is NOTHING_TO_USE, the position arm is REJECTED and dispositions 18 and 19 are never sent. Until RUNE-CAST-1 a selected session's position arm is REJECTED.
